summary: HomeStream is a trusted-LAN TypeScript ESM pnpm monorepo. Fastify 5 on Node 24 owns SQLite, TMDB, AIOStreams, FFmpeg/NVENC, the loopback ranged source cache, optional TorBox caching and health workers. React 19/Vite provides browsing, title details, HLS playback, Settings and the desktop renderer. Electron 45 adds tray, supervision and mini player. Shared Zod schemas, IPC contracts and sanitizers connect runtimes.
architecture: buildApp constructs services and thin routes. PlaybackManager owns slots, automatic candidate fallback, encoding, HLS and subtitles. Session creation returns 201 playback or 202 download tracking. Web Query hooks validate HTTP responses; Home content and idle gate background startup. Desktop distinguishes attached and owned servers with allowlisted preload IPC.
patterns: Strict TypeScript; shared Zod contracts; AppError envelopes and redaction. Offline tests isolate temp directories and random ports. No real keys/upstream calls for wiki generation. Video always re-encodes, streamId is auto, devices are not accounts, LAN-only deployment. Preserve unaffected pages byte-for-byte. Domain bylines use VeroxAUS from origin/main, excluding bots. Source references must use full repository-root paths.
changes: ReadAheadPacing supplies actual and anticipated lead separately. Closing anticipates 1.5 seconds of recent encoding speed plus the extra duration of 8 MiB in-flight input beyond the fixed four seconds; reopening still uses actual lead strictly below 120 seconds by default. Offline modeled tests cover a 184-second finished-lead gate, not a production hard guarantee.

SourceProxy caps extractor byte lead at min(effective per-source cache budget / 2, 16 MiB), releasing at half that distance. Header/tail exemptions, owner/run isolation and time holds remain. resumeAfterHold.test.ts uses 256 MiB global and per-source caps and asserts renewed upstream reads, not a measured download-rate curve.

New readAheadNotes.ts logs actual window state transitions with sessionId, state, rounded actual lead, process RSS/heap/external/arrayBuffers and cache MiB/block count. A one-second throttle is shared per proxy, sampling memory only when a line is emitted; reset of a waiting window can emit reopened.
The remaining diff is the previous generated-wiki commit, not new application work.
